notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The only lookout source is the Forest Lookouts page, which gives a name, Payette County and 'Private' and nothing else. The Wikipedia entry is for the unincorporated community of the same name; the story says the name belongs to that place and does not claim the lookout is at it. The record's coordinates (43.8082, -116.7734) were not checked against a second source. The FFLA Idaho county list has no Payette County entries, and the NHLR and FFLOS caches have no Sand Hollow page; noted for the editor only. Two web searches found news items about a Payette County wildfire near Sand Hollow Fire District but nothing about this lookout, so none are cited. Access is recorded as private; the story advises against visiting without permission and does not describe the site.
